newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells 35-day T-bills, sets new auction.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 35-day T-bills, sets new auction.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 65 million kuna through a 35-day treasury bills priced at 98.956 kuna.
The price and the rate, set at 11 percent, remained flat since the last auction on October 22.
The bills are payable on November 7 and they mature on December 12.
Bids totalled 117.5 million kuna at 9 to 11.5 percent rates. The weighted average was 10.64 percent.
The ministry will next auction 40 million kuna worth of 91-day T-bills on November 12. The auctions are not open to foreign investors. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
